note: Descriptions and captions of the photos in images/, kept by Artiscope Digital Home.

grove-gallery-23-7-26-018402.jpg.alt: A square artwork in collage and paint. A large glossy black disc with the name Konn Artiss in white capital letters sits over torn printed paper and thick strokes of yellow, red, black and pale peach paint.

banksy-statue-waterloo-place.jpg.alt: A dark statue seen from below against a grey sky: a man in a suit strides off the edge of a stone plinth while a large flag he holds blows back over his face, with scaffolded buildings behind.
banksy-statue-waterloo-place.jpg.caption: Statue by Banksy in Waterloo Place, London, installed in April 2026. Photographed in May 2026. Photo: Bex Walton, CC BY 4.0, via Wikimedia Commons: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Banksy_statue,_Waterloo_Place,_2026-05-04.jpg

yayoi-kusama-c2004.jpg.alt: Close view of Yayoi Kusama's face, with dark hair, red lipstick and pale pink glasses in a decorative silver frame.
yayoi-kusama-c2004.jpg.caption: Yayoi Kusama, around 2004. A still from George Quasha's film series art is (Speaking Portraits). Photo: George Quasha, CC BY 3.0, via Wikimedia Commons: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Yayoi_Kusama_circa_2004.jpg

el-anatsui-ambivalent-hold-nsukka.jpg.alt: A weathered grey stone sculpture of a crouching, rounded figure whose large hands cover its face, set on paving in front of a yellow concrete building.
el-anatsui-ambivalent-hold-nsukka.jpg.caption: Ambivalent Hold, from a design by El Anatsui, made by the SKEP art collective for the Physical Sciences building at the University of Nigeria, Nsukka. Photographed in 2024. Photo: Mercyjamb123, CC BY-SA 4.0, via Wikimedia Commons: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:El_Anatsui,_Ambivalent_Hold,_at_the_physical_science_building_in_university_of_Nsukka.jpg

s-h-raza-delhi-2011.jpg.alt: S.H. Raza, an elderly man with white hair and glasses in a pale suit, seated and leaning over a sheet of paper as people gather close around him.
s-h-raza-delhi-2011.jpg.caption: S.H. Raza at an art summit in Delhi, January 2011. Photo: Chetan Nikam, CC BY-SA 4.0, via Wikimedia Commons: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:SH_Raza_1.JPG

gerhard-richter-prague-2017.jpg.alt: Portrait of Gerhard Richter, an older man with white hair, a short white beard and round dark glasses, in a dark coat, looking at the camera.
gerhard-richter-prague-2017.jpg.caption: Gerhard Richter at the National Gallery, Prague, in April 2017. Photo: Jindřich Nosek (NoJin), CC BY-SA 4.0, via Wikimedia Commons: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Gerhard_Richter_(2017).jpg

vhils-berlin-chausseestrasse.jpg.alt: A large portrait of a man in a cap, made by chipping away the pale plaster of a tall brown city wall to show the darker layers beneath.
vhils-berlin-chausseestrasse.jpg.caption: Joe Hatchiban, a wall portrait carved by Vhils (Alexandre Farto) in Berlin in 2011. Photographed in 2013. Photo: OTFW, Berlin, CC BY-SA 3.0, via Wikimedia Commons: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Wandbild_Chausseestr_36_(Mitte)_Joe_Hatchiban-Alexandre_Farto-2011.jpg

osgemeos-mam-sao-paulo.jpg.alt: A long, brightly coloured mural of yellow-skinned figures in patterned clothes, a giant sleeping face, floating trees and railway tracks running across an orange desert under a purple sky.
osgemeos-mam-sao-paulo.jpg.caption: Mural by OSGEMEOS at the entrance to the Museu de Arte Moderna in Ibirapuera Park, São Paulo, photographed in March 2011. Photo: André Deak for Arte Fora do Museu, CC BY 2.0, via Wikimedia Commons: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Grafite_na_entrada_do_MAM,_osgemeos_(5878023404).jpg

faith47-cologne.jpg.alt: A tall painted figure in a dark hooded robe, face lifted and lit from one side, fills the pale green end wall of a block of flats. Bare trees stand in front and ivy climbs the brick beside it.
faith47-cologne.jpg.caption: Mural by Faith XLVII on the end wall of a block of flats in Cologne, photographed in February 2015. Photo: Raimond Spekking, CC BY-SA 4.0, via Wikimedia Commons: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Wandgem%C3%A4lde_Wi%C3%9Fmannstra%C3%9Fe_17,_Faith47-4696.jpg

pablo-picasso-1908.jpg.alt: Black and white photograph of the young Pablo Picasso, with short dark hair, in a dark jacket, looking to one side.
pablo-picasso-1908.jpg.caption: Pablo Picasso in 1908. Photographer unknown. Public domain, via Wikimedia Commons: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Portrait_de_Picasso,_1908.jpg

jean-michel-basquiat-1984.jpg.alt: Jean-Michel Basquiat in 1984, a young man with short dreadlocks, photographed indoors.
jean-michel-basquiat-1984.jpg.caption: Jean-Michel Basquiat, 15 September 1984. Photo: Galerie Bruno Bischofberger, CC BY-SA 4.0, via Wikimedia Commons: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Basquiat1984.tif

keith-haring-stedelijk-1986.jpg.alt: Black and white photograph of Keith Haring, a young man with short hair and round glasses, at work on a large painted surface.
keith-haring-stedelijk-1986.jpg.caption: Keith Haring at the Stedelijk Museum, Amsterdam, 14 March 1986. Photo: Rob Bogaerts / Anefo, Nationaal Archief, CC0, via Wikimedia Commons: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Keith_Haring_(1986).jpg

david-hockney-2017.jpg.alt: David Hockney in a flat cap, round black glasses and a striped cardigan.
david-hockney-2017.jpg.caption: David Hockney in 2017. Photo: Connaissance des Arts, CC BY 3.0, via Wikimedia Commons: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:David_Hockney_2017_at_Flash_Expo_(cropped).jpg

damien-hirst-2012.jpg.alt: Damien Hirst, a man with close-cropped hair in a dark jacket, standing in a gallery.
damien-hirst-2012.jpg.caption: Damien Hirst at Gagosian, New York, 11 January 2012. Photo: Andrew Russeth, CC BY-SA 2.0, via Wikimedia Commons: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Damien_Hirst_(6712601473).jpg

david-shrigley-2011.jpg.alt: David Shrigley, a tall man with a shaved head and glasses, photographed in 2011.
david-shrigley-2011.jpg.caption: David Shrigley in 2011. Photo: Andy Miah, CC BY-SA 2.0, via Wikimedia Commons: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:David_Shrigley.jpg

ben-eine-love-at-first-sight-zurich.jpg.alt: The end wall of a city building painted black and covered in stacked, striped capital letters in pink, yellow, green and blue, spelling LOVE AT FIRST SIGHT.
ben-eine-love-at-first-sight-zurich.jpg.caption: LOVE AT FIRST SIGHT by Ben Eine, Ausstellungsstrasse, Zürich, photographed in August 2023. Photo: Balise42, CC BY 4.0, via Wikimedia Commons.

jr-ted-2011.jpg.alt: JR in a black hat, dark glasses, checked shirt and blue jacket, photographed indoors in 2011.
jr-ted-2011.jpg.caption: JR in March 2011, the year he won the TED Prize. Photo: Mohamed Nanabhay, CC BY 2.0, via Wikimedia Commons: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:JR_(artist).jpg

takashi-murakami-geisai-2006.jpg.alt: Takashi Murakami in a dark jacket and glasses, seated on a tall stool at a small table on a stage.
takashi-murakami-geisai-2006.jpg.caption: Takashi Murakami at GEISAI#10, Tokyo, 17 September 2006. Photo: Yamashita Yohei, CC BY 2.0, via Wikimedia Commons: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Takashi_Murakami_o.jpg

ai-weiwei-sao-paulo-2018.jpg.alt: Ai Weiwei, grey-bearded, in a blue-grey shirt, seated in front of a purple stage curtain.
ai-weiwei-sao-paulo-2018.jpg.caption: Ai Weiwei at Fronteiras do Pensamento, São Paulo, 10 October 2018. Photo: Greg Salibian for Fronteiras do Pensamento, CC BY-SA 2.0, via Wikimedia Commons: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:2018-10-10_Ai_Weiwei_no_Fronteiras_do_Pensamento_S%C3%A3o_Paulo_2018,_001.jpg

william-kentridge-2025.jpg.alt: William Kentridge, white-haired, in a white open-necked shirt, smiling slightly.
william-kentridge-2025.jpg.caption: William Kentridge in 2025. Photo: Mozamaniac, CC BY-SA 4.0, via Wikimedia Commons: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:William_Kentridge_(2025)_(cropped).jpg

mai-trung-thu-and-father.jpg.alt: Black and white photograph of the young Mai Trung Thứ standing beside his father, an older man with a white beard.
mai-trung-thu-and-father.jpg.caption: Mai Trung Thứ with his father, Mai Trung Cát, before 1945. Photographer unknown, public domain, via Wikimedia Commons: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Mai_Trung_Thu_(1906-1980)_and_his_father_Mai_Trung_Cat_(1857-1945).png

frida-kahlo-frissell-1937.jpg.alt: Black and white photograph of Frida Kahlo in a long skirt, seated on rocky ground beside a large agave plant.
frida-kahlo-frissell-1937.jpg.caption: Frida Kahlo photographed by Toni Frissell, 1937. Library of Congress, public domain, via Wikimedia Commons: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Toni_Frissell_-_Frida_Kahlo,_seated_next_to_an_agave.jpg

mona-hatoum-ivam-2021.jpg.alt: Mona Hatoum, with dark curly hair and glasses, in a striped top, seen in front of shelves of files.
mona-hatoum-ivam-2021.jpg.caption: Mona Hatoum in April 2021. Photo: Miguel Lorenzo, IVAM, CC BY-SA 4.0, via Wikimedia Commons: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Mona_Hatoum.jpg

zanele-muholi-2011.jpg.alt: Zanele Muholi, in a dark hat and patterned top, speaking in a gallery while people with cameras listen.
zanele-muholi-2011.jpg.caption: Zanele Muholi, left, at the Side by Side LGBT Film Festival, 22 October 2011. Photo: Side by Side LGBT Film Festival, CC BY-SA 3.0, via Wikimedia Commons: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Zanele_Muholi._Festival_%C2%ABSide_by_Side%C2%BB.JPG

vincent-van-gogh-self-portrait-1887.jpg.alt: Vincent van Gogh's self-portrait of 1887: his head and shoulders in short strokes of orange, blue and green, with a red beard and a sideways look.
vincent-van-gogh-self-portrait-1887.jpg.caption: Vincent van Gogh, Self-Portrait, 1887. Art Institute of Chicago. Public domain, via Wikimedia Commons.

wassily-kandinsky-erfurth-1923.jpg.alt: Black and white photograph of Wassily Kandinsky in a dark suit, white collar and round glasses, seated with his hands folded on his knee.
wassily-kandinsky-erfurth-1923.jpg.caption: Wassily Kandinsky photographed by Hugo Erfurth in 1923. Public domain, via Wikimedia Commons.

dana-awartani-venice-2026.jpg.alt: Dana Awartani, smiling, with long dark hair, in a denim shirt and a wooden bead necklace.
dana-awartani-venice-2026.jpg.caption: Dana Awartani at the Venice Biennale, May 2026. Photo: Hano, CC BY-SA 4.0, via Wikimedia Commons (cropped).

philip-colbert-studio-2022.jpg.alt: Philip Colbert in a red suit and red and white trainers, sitting on a white plinth in a gallery space, with lobster sculptures and a round painting behind him.
philip-colbert-studio-2022.jpg.caption: Philip Colbert in his studio, September 2022. Photo: Gpc9, CC BY-SA 4.0, via Wikimedia Commons.

jenny-holzer-erlauf-peace-memorial.jpg.alt: A tall pale stone column among young birch trees and low planting at dusk, with houses behind.
jenny-holzer-erlauf-peace-memorial.jpg.caption: Jenny Holzer's peace memorial in Erlauf, Lower Austria, which marks the first meeting of Allied forces in Austria on 8 May 1945. Photo: Herzi Pinki, CC BY-SA 4.0, via Wikimedia Commons.

mohamed-lghacham-table-is-set-vienna.jpg.alt: A mural covering the end wall of a five-storey block of flats: a family gathered round an outdoor table among trees and sunflowers, with parked cars and scooters in front.
mohamed-lghacham-table-is-set-vienna.jpg.caption: the table is set, a mural by Mohamed L'Ghacham painted for the Calle Libre festival in 2025, Ruttenstockgasse, Vienna. Photo: Skunk, CC BY-SA 4.0, via Wikimedia Commons.
